what: With the screen pinned, scrolling makes fourteen cards roll in from outside the lower left, leaning at 13° steps around a big wheel below the screen (radius .9 of screen height · vertical .96 squash · 6% down), at 10~16% of the section, −6.5 slots → 0 slots, power2.out. Then during 16~78% the wheel turns one slot at a time, bringing the cards to the top in turn (cards more than 15° from the top .95x, top card lifted 16%). At 78~100% they settle with smoothstep from the wheel position into a grid 94% of the screen width (width 1280+ seven columns, two rows, card width .16 · gap .016). With park on, at 59~79% of the section they gather into a pile at the bottom-right corner (.42x, ±3° staggered) — hover fans them out to 22vw on the left in .4s power2.out, and pressing returns them to the grid — then at 79~100% they scatter to fourteen spots at the screen edge (.5x), each card delayed by a .2 share. Scroll follow scrub .6, snapping to the boundary before the roll-in and just before the grid (.15~.5s power1.inOut). Changing the filter (fx:wheel-filter) makes the remaining cards pop into the new grid with back.out(2.2) .7s, staggered by .03s

options.drop: Amount the wheel lowers (screen height), default .06
options.park: 1 puts a corner-pile and scatter stage after the grid (board defaults: wheel-end .47 · park-start .59 · scatter-start .79). 0 makes wheel and grid cover the whole board
options.park-scale · scatter-scale: Stack and scattered card scale, default .42 · .5
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Pinned stage (100vh) — cards are positioned relative to the stage center
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card (the card body whose first child lifts) · data-tags="a b" as a filter tag
options.[data-fx-part=park]: (If present) slot that receives interaction over the corner pile
options.Event: el receives fx:wheel (detail p·wheel·title·grid·park·scatter — matching the opacity of other sections) · fx:wheel-card (detail card·x·y — card press, open detail), and it listens for fx:wheel-filter (detail tag | all) · fx:wheel-jump (detail frac·duration) when they are sent

use: …
note: With reduced motion it is not pinned and sits straight in the grid. Other sections (title, filter, About panel, closing form) are layered on the stage and toggled on and off like the original with fx:wheel’s title·grid·park·scatter (the showcase copy index.js is the model)
